browserScope: Upstream light pages, keyboard response, settled readouts, widths1440/390, reduced-motion preference, WebGL available/disabled. Axe scans at390. Not a complete accessibility conformance or child-usability test.
notRun: supervised child usability and transfer pilot

corrections: Loop readouts and source derive from the selected repeat count.
Countable tray slots and preset answers remain hidden until prediction reveal.
Isometric quarter turns are named separately from orthographic views.
Default fixture and transfer presets match between class plan and prompt.
